lines: Dukh sukh tha ek sab ka, apna ho ya begaana
couplets.en: We shared our joys and sorrows, kin and stranger alike.

lines: Ek woh bhi tha zamaana, ek yeh bhi hai zamaana
couplets.en: Those were the times we knew, and these are the times we live in.

lines: Dukh sukh tha ek sab ka, apna ho ya begaana
couplets.en: We shared our joys and sorrows, kin and stranger alike.

lines: Ek woh bhi tha zamaana, ek yeh bhi hai zamaana
couplets.en: Those were the times we knew, and these are the times we live in.

lines: Daada ke waqt mein jab mitti ka ek ghar tha
couplets.en: In Grandfather's day, we lived in a house of earth.

lines: Choron ka koi khatka, na daakuon ka dar tha
couplets.en: We had no fear of thieves or bandits.

lines: Daada ke waqt mein jab mitti ka ek ghar tha
couplets.en: In Grandfather's day, we lived in a house of earth.

lines: Choron ka koi khatka, na daakuon ka dar tha
couplets.en: We had no fear of thieves or bandits.

lines: Khaate the rookhi sookhi, sote the neend gehri
couplets.en: Our meals were plain, and we slept soundly.

lines: Shaamein bhari bhari thi, aabaad thi dupehri
couplets.en: The evenings felt full, and the afternoons were alive.

lines: Apna ho ya begaana
couplets.en: It was the same for kin and stranger alike.

lines: Ek woh bhi tha zamaana, ek yeh bhi hai zamaana
couplets.en: Those were the times we knew, and these are the times we live in.

lines: Abba ka waqt aaya, taaleem ghar mein aayi
couplets.en: In Father's day, learning came into our home.

lines: Taaleem saath apne taaza vichaar laayi
couplets.en: Learning brought fresh ideas with it.

lines: Aage rivaayaton se badhne ka dhyaan aaya
couplets.en: We began to think beyond the old ways.

lines: Mitti ka ghar hata to pakka makaan aaya
couplets.en: A brick house took the place of our earthen home.

lines: Daftar ki naukri thi, tankhwaah ka sahaara
couplets.en: An office job gave us a salary to rely on.

lines: Maalik pe tha bharosa, ho jaata tha guzaara
couplets.en: We put our trust in God and got by.

lines: Paisa agarche kam tha, phir bhi na koi gham tha
couplets.en: Money was scarce, yet it weighed lightly on us.

lines: Kaisa bhara poora tha, apna ghareeb khaana
couplets.en: How full of life our humble home was.

lines: Dukh sukh tha ek sab ka, apna ho ya begaana
couplets.en: We shared our joys and sorrows, kin and stranger alike.

lines: Ek woh bhi tha zamaana, ek yeh bhi hai zamaana
couplets.en: Those were the times we knew, and these are the times we live in.

lines: Ab mera daur hai yeh, koi nahin kisi ka
couplets.en: Now it is my generation's turn, and no one stands by another.

lines: Har aadmi akela, har chehra ajnabi sa
couplets.en: Everyone is alone, and every face seems unfamiliar.

lines: Aansoo na muskuraahat, jeevan ka haal aisa
couplets.en: Life has come to this, without tears or smiles.

lines: Apni khabar nahin hai, maaya ka jaal aisa
couplets.en: The world has caught us in its web, and we have lost sight of ourselves.

lines: Paisa hai, martaba hai, izzat, waqaar bhi hai
couplets.en: We have money, standing, respect and dignity.

lines: Naukar hain aur chaakar, bangla hai, car bhi hai
couplets.en: We have servants, a bungalow and a car.

lines: Zar paas hai, zameen hai, lekin sukoon nahin hai
couplets.en: We have wealth and land, yet peace eludes us.

lines: Paane ke vaaste kuch, kya kya pada ganwaana
couplets.en: How much we lost to gain so little.

lines: Dukh sukh tha ek sab ka, apna ho ya begaana
couplets.en: We shared our joys and sorrows, kin and stranger alike.

lines: Ek woh bhi tha zamaana, ek yeh bhi hai zamaana
couplets.en: Those were the times we knew, and these are the times we live in.

lines: Ae aane waali naslon, ae aane waale logon
couplets.en: I speak to you who will come after us.

lines: Bhoga hai humne jo kuch, woh tum kabhi na bhogo
couplets.en: May you never have to live through what we did.

lines: Jo dukh tha saath apne, tum se qareeb na ho
couplets.en: May the sorrow that kept us company never come near you.

lines: Peeda jo humne jheli, tumko naseeb na ho
couplets.en: May the pain we bore never be yours.

lines: Jis tarah bheed mein hum zinda rahe akele
couplets.en: Even among crowds, we lived alone.

lines: Woh zindagi ki mehfil, tum se na koi le le
couplets.en: May no one take from you the companionship that makes a life.

lines: Tum jis taraf se guzro, mela ho roshni ka
couplets.en: May every road you take be bright with lights.

lines: Raas aaye tumko mausam, ikkeesween sadi ka
couplets.en: May the seasons of the new century be kind to you.

lines: Hum to sukoon ko tarse, tum par sukoon barse
couplets.en: We longed for peace, and may it fall like rain upon you.

lines: Aanand ho dilon mein, jeevan lage suhaana
couplets.en: May your hearts know joy and life feel sweet.
